BUN_VERSION.description: Version of Bun demanded. Can be a specific version number like 'bun-v1.1.0' or an alias.

BUN_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install BUN. 'libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools.
